title: Verifier: audit_local.py accepts non-centre cut gates; additive guard and regression fixture (no new κ)
head: aa5baad1882b2d55af2667cf700527521930fdbf
body:
## Summary

**Verifier gap, no new κ.** The independent local auditor `research/gauge44-frames-x/independent/audit_local.py` climbs frames only in sections A and B. In the cut, it checks only gates whose source is a centre. Any other cut gate is applied to the scalar map but never frame-checked, so a word can move priced work into the unpriced cut and still pass with an understated paid profile.

The native provider chain catches it, so claims whose admission runs the native chain are not affected. That includes every T74 claim. The gap matters for any acceptance that relies on the auditor alone.

Package: `research/audit-local-cut-centre-guard/`, outcome `completed` (task card `supplier-boundary-audit`, scope refined).

## Counterexample

`inputs/PROBE-CUT-502.json.gz` starts from the genuine base word of the pivot-566+554 T74 supplier (PR #1672's `gauge44-word-566`) and makes three changes:
- width-9 helper 502 becomes entering (start frame of dimension 1), so its width drops to 8;
- four cut gates `200/203/205/206 += ±½ · 502` cancel its initial-value leak;
- its two A-section writes are re-timed into B.

| Check | Base word | Probe |
|---|---|---|
| Unchanged `audit_local.py --main` | PASS (7,208 compensation gates, 192 entering) | **PASS** (7,204 gates, 193 entering, local profile `{2: 501, 3: 415}`: one rank level less, about 2.1M units per call) |
| Native chain (PR635 scripts via PR #1186's `native.py`) | PASS, all 5 steps | **FAIL** at `hpe_emit_local.py`: `emitted column mismatch`, register 153 |
| `guard.py` (this PR) | PASS | **FAIL**: exactly the 4 non-centre cut gates |

## The guard

`guard.py` (standard library) requires every cut gate to be an `add` whose source is one of the word's eight centres and whose target is a target row (`v <= t < 2v`). Every genuine word has this structure, and the native emitter relies on it.
- It accepts all 146 genuine `CANONICAL-WORD`/`FULL-WORD` files with a cut at the base commit, plus both supplier words (`evidence/GUARD-GENUINE-WORDS.json`).
- It rejects exactly the probe's four gates.

`audit_local.py` is pinned by hash in 421 files at the base commit, so this PR **does not modify it**. The guard is additive: it can run alongside the auditor or be folded into a new auditor version, whichever maintainers prefer.

## Verification

- `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/audit-local-cut-centre-guard` gives `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed`, in about 1 s.
  - It checks the input pins, including both declared repository inputs: the auditor, and the parent `CANONICAL-WORD.json.gz` that its `--main` interface check reads. Then it runs the unchanged auditor on the base and probe words; both pass, with receipts equal to `evidence/AUDIT-*.json`.
  - It runs the guard on all three words, with two mutation controls (a non-centre cut source, a non-target cut row).
  - `-O` is refused.
- The native rejection is recorded evidence (`evidence/NATIVE-PROBE.txt`), not rerun in the hook.
- `tests/test_research_*.py`: 65 tests OK, 3 skipped.
- **Revision 2** (`aa5baad1`, after the maintainer's [review](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2478#issuecomment-6204476856)):
  - The parent word `research/community-k492-audit/pr622/replay/baseline558/complex-global/base/split-centres/CANONICAL-WORD.json.gz` is now declared in `VERIFY.json` and `SOURCES.json`: base `0fdd7d82`, source commit `5c5567d1`, blob `a2e5a1ff`, SHA256 `66d3c3c7…`.
  - A Git-free export with only the package and its two declared inputs passes `verify.py`. The previous head fails there with `FileNotFoundError`.
  - Deleting or altering the parent word in the export fails the pin check with a named message.

## Open next questions

- **Version the guard into the auditor,** or into the registered replays that call it. The first step is done: @ywz65's [screen](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2478#issuecomment-6192363481) found seven registered packages that actually call the auditor. Their committed words pass the guard with an unchanged 176-gate cut (re-run here on the six distinct words), and no existing claim is shown to use the gap. Adoption waits on a maintainer decision about versioning the pinned auditor.
- **Check the other unpriced sections** (precondition, derived compensation, frame-free cleanup) for analogous counterexamples.

## Credit

- The auditor is icekylinx's gauge44-frames-x.
- The words are PR #1672's (Jeremy Kothe / LeverRank) on PR #1625's words, in the PR #1319/#1297 lineage (Rohan Arun) and its ancestry.
- The native chain is PR635's vendored scripts.
- The registered-consumer screen is ywz65's.

Found during our T74 local-word rounds (discussion #2143). See `NOTICE.md`.
